kaikki_vikisozluk.e: بَصْمَة • (baṣma) f (plural بَصَمَات (baṣamāt))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Borrowed from Ottoman Turkish باصمه (basma, “printed, something pressed”). Analyzed as an instance noun (on the pattern of such words as رَسْمَة (rasma, “a drawing; an artwork”) and بَسْمَة (basma, “a smile”)), forming the denominal root ب ص م (b ṣ m).

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: بَصَمَ • (baṣama) I (non-past يَبْصُمُ (yabṣumu), verbal noun بَصْم (baṣm))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Denominal verb from بَصْمَة (baṣma, “imprint”).
g: to thumbprint, to affix, to leave as a mark

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: بَصْم • (baṣm) m
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Denominal verb from بَصْمَة (baṣma, “imprint”).
